brief.q: Discuss Robotics and its applications.
a: Robotics: Robotics is an interdisciplinary branch of computer science and mechanical engineering that involves the design, manufacture, operation and use of robots. Robotics aims to create intelligent machines that can assist humans in various ways.
Applications: Robots are mostly used in: (i) Manufacturing industries (ii) The medical field (iii) Agriculture (iv) The military (v) Entertainment.

brief.q: What is Artificial Intelligence? How is it helpful for humans?
a: Artificial Intelligence (AI): AI refers to technologies that enable devices to perform tasks and make decisions in ways similar to humans. AI can include features such as voice recognition and decision-making.

Helpful for Humans: AI has the potential to be helpful to humans by automating routine tasks, improving efficiency, and enabling new forms of innovation and discovery. However, it is important to consider ethical and societal implications as AI becomes more integrated into our daily lives.

brief.q: Who does operate a self-driven car?
a: As the name suggests, a self-driving car operates autonomously, meaning it does not require a human driver to control it. Instead, the car's sensors and software handle tasks such as navigating, accelerating, and braking.

brief.q: Write down the functions of the USB Port.
a: Functions of the USB Port: The USB (Universal Serial Bus) port serves as a plug-and-play interface that enables a computer to communicate with various peripherals and devices. Some functions include:

(1) Connecting a wide range of peripherals and devices to a computer, such as computer keyboards and mice, printers, disk drives, network adapters, video cameras, portable media players, and mobile digital telephones.
(2) Providing a convenient and standardized method for connecting and disconnecting devices without the need to shut down the computer.
(3) Enabling high-speed data transfer between the computer and connected devices.
(4) Replacing older types of connectors, such as PS/2, game, serial, and parallel ports, which are now obsolete.
Overall, the USB port serves as a versatile and widely-used interface for connecting devices to a computer.

brief.q: What is the usage of SATA port?
a: Usage of the SATA Port: The usage of the SATA port is to enable storage devices, such as hard drives and optical drives, to communicate with the motherboard using a high-speed serial cable over two pairs of conductors. This allows for efficient and durable connection of external hard drives to the motherboard, and the ability to plug hard drives in and out of the ports without switching off the computer.

brief.q: For which purpose do we use PCIe?
a: Use of PCIe: PCIe slots can be used to add various components such as GPUs (video cards, graphics cards), Wi-Fi cards, or SSD cards to a desktop PC. Therefore, the purpose of using PCIe is to expand and enhance the functionality of a computer system by adding high-speed components via the PCIe interface.

brief.q: Discuss Computer Peripherals.
a: Computer Peripherals: Peripheral devices are also known as Peripherals, computer peripherals or input/output devices.
Kinds of Peripherals: Peripherals are commonly divided into three kinds: (1) Input Devices (2) Output Devices (3) Storage Devices.

brief.q: Discuss printers and their types.
a: Printers: A printer is an output device that prints on paper. Printers print text documents, images, or a combination of both. The two most common types of printers are inkjet and laser printers. Laser printers are a typical choice for businesses as well as individuals.
Types of Printers:
(1) Inkjet printers: Inkjet printers recreate a digital image by spraying ink on paper and are mostly used as personal printers.

(2) Laser Printers: Laser printers are used to create high-quality prints by passing a laser beam at high speed over a negatively charged drum to create an image. Colour laser printers are more often found in offices.

(3) 3D Printers: 3D printers are a relatively new printer technology. 3D printing creates a physical object from a digital file by adding layer upon layer of material until the print job is complete and the object is whole.
(4) LED Printers: LED printers are similar to laser printers but use a light-emitting diode array in the print head instead of a laser.

brief.q: For which purposes do we use Scanner?
a: We use a scanner as an input device to capture images from paper and convert them into a digital form that can be stored in a computer. This allows users to edit and modify the captured images before printing them, and to store them in a digital format for long-term preservation and easier sharing. The main purposes of using a scanner are to digitise physical documents, images, or other visual materials, and to facilitate their manipulation and sharing using digital technology.

brief.q: Discuss the main properties of the Scanner.
a: Properties of a Scanner:
(1) Resolution: One of the essential features of the scanner is the resolution that it is capable of capturing, measured in dots per inch. More dots per inch means higher quality of scanning.
(2) Colour depth: Colour depth refers to the number of bits needed for the representation of the colour of each pixel. The higher the colour depth, the more colours the scanner can capture.

(3) Recognition: To scan a document, optical character recognition is essential. The computer must convert the file to a text document to identify alphanumeric characters. A scanner provides this facility.

brief.q: What is the function of a Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) / Graphics Card?
a: The function of a Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) / Graphics Card is rendering visual data that is outputted to a display device such as a monitor. It takes the load off the CPU and allows for high-quality visual display.

brief.q: What are some examples of advanced graphical techniques used by a graphics card?
a: Advanced graphical techniques used by a graphics card can include ray tracing, anti-aliasing, and texture filtering, which improve the quality of images and reduce visual artifacts.

detailed.q: Define Emerging Technology, discuss three real-world examples.
a: Emerging Technology: The term emerging technology is generally used to describe new technology. It may also refer to the advancement in existing technology. The development of emerging technologies also refers to technical, institutional and social changes.

Characteristics: (i) Innovation (ii) Fast growth (iii) Consistency (iv) Prominent impact. Emerging technologies have created new opportunities and challenges related to copyrights, patents, licensing etc.
Examples: (i) Robotics (ii) Artificial Intelligence (iii) Self-Driving Cars (iv) 3D Printing (v) Virtual Reality (vi) Augmented Reality (vii) 3D and Holographic Imaging.

(1) Robotics: An interdisciplinary branch of computer science and mechanical engineering that involves the design, manufacture, operation and use of robots, mostly used in manufacturing industries, the medical field, agriculture, the military, and entertainment.
(2) Artificial Intelligence (AI): Technologies that make devices act and think like a human. Voice recognition and decision-making are features of human intelligence that AI may possess.

(3) Self-driving cars: A self-driving car, also known as a robotic car, is capable of sensing its environment and moving safely with little or no human input. Companies such as Google and Tesla have been developing and using self-driven cars for several years.

detailed.q: What is Holographic imaging? Discuss its application.
a: Holographic imaging: A hologram is a three-dimensional image, created with photographic projection. Unlike 3D or virtual reality on a two-dimensional computer display, a hologram is a truly three-dimensional and free-standing image.
Applications:

(1) Art and Entertainment: Used in art installations, performances, and exhibitions to create interactive and immersive experiences, and in film/television for special effects and realistic animations.
(2) Medical Imaging: Used in medical research and diagnosis to create detailed and accurate 3D models of human anatomy for surgical planning, training, and education.
(3) Security: Used in security features on credit cards, passports, and other important documents to prevent counterfeiting, and in authentication and verification systems.
(4) Education: Used in education and training to create interactive and immersive learning experiences, and in museums and historical sites for virtual tours and exhibits.
(5) Industrial Design and Manufacturing: Used in product design and prototyping to create 3D models and simulations, and to improve quality control and reduce errors.

detailed.q: Discuss Computer Ports and their types.
a: Computer Ports: A port is a physical point or a jack provided on a computer using which an external device can be connected to the computer.

Working/Functioning: It acts as an interface or point of attachment between the computer and external devices, and can also be a point through which information flows from a program to the computer or over the Internet.
Types: (i) USB Port (ii) Type-C Port (iii) HDMI Port (iv) SATA Port.

USB Port: A plug-and-play interface that allows a computer to communicate with peripherals and other devices, replacing older PS/2, game, serial, and parallel ports. Peripherals connected via USB include keyboards, mice, video cameras, printers, portable media players, disk drives, and network adapters.
USB Specifications — Versions:

The latest design of the USB port, with 24 pins. Used for fast charging and high-speed data transfer. Has no up or down orientation, making it easier to plug in devices.
Stands for Serial Advanced Technology Attachment. Connects storage devices such as hard drives and optical drives to a motherboard, enabling high-speed data transfer and hot-swapping.
A hardware component that generates and outputs images to a display device such as a monitor, designed to handle complex graphics processing tasks like rendering 3D images, gaming, or CAD software.
An input device that captures video and audio for real-time communication over the internet — commonly used for video conferencing, online streaming, and recording videos.

crq.q: What is 3D printing and how does it work?
a: 3D printing is a process that creates a physical object from a digital design. It works by layering materials on top of each other until the object is fully formed.

crq.q: In what industries is VR technology widely used?
a: VR technology is widely used in the medical and manufacturing industries.

crq.q: What is an input device, and give some examples?
a: An input device is any hardware device that sends data to a computer, allowing you to interact with and control it. Examples include keyboards, mice, and scanners.

crq.q: What is an output device, and give some examples?
a: An output device is a piece of computer hardware that receives data from a computer and translates it into audio, visual, textual, or hard copy such as a printed document. Examples include monitors, printers, and speakers.

crq.q: How does a scanner work, and what is it used for?
a: A scanner is an input device that works like a photocopy machine. It captures images from paper and converts them into a digital form that can be stored in a computer, used when information needs to be transferred from paper for further manipulation.

crq.q: What is the purpose of a webcam, and how is it used?
a: A webcam is a video camera attached to a computer to record or stream video. It is primarily used for live-streaming or social media, and can be used for still images, video recording, and video conferencing.

crq.q: What is a graphics card, and how does it work?
a: A graphics card is an expansion card that generates output images to a display device, such as a monitor. It provides high-quality visual display by processing and executing graphical data using advanced graphical techniques. It is primarily designed to remove graphical processing tasks from the processor or RAM, and includes a dedicated GPU and dedicated RAM.

crq.q: What is 3D imaging, and why is it important in industrial and consumer applications?
a: 3D imaging is a process of creating a three-dimensional image on a two-dimensional surface. It is important because it can be used for product design, prototyping, and quality control, among other things.

crq.q: How is virtual reality technology used in the medical and manufacturing industries?
a: Virtual reality technology is used in the medical industry to simulate surgical procedures and train medical professionals. In the manufacturing industry, it is used for product design and prototyping.

crq.q: What is the role of augmented reality in medical science?
a: Augmented reality can be used in medical science for applications such as medical training, assisting in surgeries, and visualisation of medical imaging data.

crq.q: How does a joystick work as an input device?
a: A joystick is an input device typically used for gaming. It allows the user to control the movement of a game character by moving the joystick in different directions.

crq.q: What is a trackball and how does it work as an input device?
a: A trackball is an input device that functions like a mouse, but with a ball on top used to control the cursor. The user rotates the ball with their fingers to move the cursor on the screen.

crq.q: How does a microphone work as an input device?
a: A microphone is an input device that converts sound waves into an electrical signal that can be processed by a computer. It is commonly used for recording audio or for voice communication.

crq.q: How does a touchscreen work as an input device?
a: A touchscreen is an input device that allows the user to interact with a computer by touching the screen with their fingers. The screen uses sensors to detect the location and pressure of the user's touch.

crq.q: What are some common applications of 3D imaging technology in consumer products?
a: 3D imaging technology can be used in smartphones for facial recognition, video games for more realistic graphics, and virtual try-on features for online shopping.

brief.q: Write a note on benefits of Microsoft PowerPoint which adds importance to any presentations for any kind of user.
a: Some benefits of Microsoft PowerPoint which add importance to any of the presentations for any kind of user:

(1) Point-to-Point Focus: PowerPoint helps in driving presentation-focused detail by pointing out important ideas or points through the slides. Rather than writing paragraphs or stories on what you would like to present, a detailed statement with some voice or Animated or Graphical representation will make it more eye-catching and interesting for listeners.

(2) Attractive Visuals: Visual representation leaves an impression in our mind rather than listening to verbal statements. PowerPoint has different multimedia options that will help users to represent with a colourful background, text and animation giving striking look to the representation.
(3) Numerous Resources: PowerPoint has numerous features to add references from the internet with a single click offering a series of cues.

(4) Breaking the complexity: With the Presentation, the presenter gets the chance to use his skills to represent in a simpler way and saves the efforts of users and his own. PowerPoint also has the capability of using laser pointers for narration which helps the presenter to have eye-eye contact with the audience at the same time concentrating on the bullet points.

(5) User Ownership: PowerPoint gives an option to digital signature to the presentation that will not let any of users the modify or add any of the content to the presentation without the consent of the user.

(6) Multimedia capability: PowerPoint has the ability to convert the presentation into Video or audio and can be shared on the Internet and can be saved on DVD through a DVD burner for parties, functions, academics, entertainment, etc. It also has the capability to be viewed on any device like iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Blueberry etc.

brief.q: State the different ways in which we can use email as a mean of authentication for another website.
a: There are three common authentication types:
(1) Password-based authentication: Passwords are the most common methods of authentication.
(2) Certificate-based authentication: Uses digital certificates to identify users.
(3) Biometric authentication: Uses unique biological characteristics like fingerprints or facial recognition to authenticate.

brief.q: Discuss the importance and uses of email.
a: Importance of Email: An email is an essential tool for communication in today's modern world, and it has several advantages that make it a preferred choice for personal, professional, or academic communication. Key reasons include saving time/money, user-friendliness, simple documentation, and easy sharing of file attachments.
Uses of Email:
1. Communicate with people all over the world for free.
2. Connect with more than one person at a time by sending group mails.
3. Document interactions for future reference.
4. Work in collaboration on mutual projects.
5. Send attachments like images, files, or documents.

brief.q: Write the proper protocol of signing out the email account when not using it.
a: When you are not using a personal device to access your email account, it is always safe to log out to prevent unauthorized access to your account. Follow the proper protocol outlined below:
(1) Click on your user profile or username icon on the top right of the page, and a menu will be displayed.
(2) From the menu options, click on the 'Sign out' button.
By following these steps, you will be securely signed out of your email account, and any unauthorized person will not be able to access your account without your login credentials.

brief.q: Elaborate on the use of thesaurus and synonyms features in Microsoft Word.
a: The Thesaurus is a software tool that is used in Microsoft Word to look up (find) synonyms (words with the same meaning) and antonyms (words with the opposite meaning) for the selected word.
Steps to use Thesaurus:
1. Open a new or existing Word document.
2. Highlight the typed or selected word you want to check.
3. Right-click on the selected word to open the drop-down context menu.
4. Place the cursor on the Synonyms option.
5. Click on the word from the list that you think fits best.

brief.q: Describe the purpose of a word processor.
a: Purpose of A Word Processor: The word processor is one of the most-used computer applications in education. There are four primary functions of word processors which are:
1. Composing: Typing and generating new document text.
2. Editing: Modifying existing text, spelling corrections, etc.
3. Saving: Preserving the file onto secondary storage.
4. Printing: Generating physical paper copies of the document.

brief.q: Identify and explain the common platforms for electronic mail.
a: Electronic mail, commonly known as email, has several platforms or providers that offer email services:
(1) Gmail: A free email service offered by Google. It is widely used due to its simple interface, high storage capacity, and integration with other Google services.
(2) Microsoft Outlook: An email and personal information manager provided by Microsoft, offering calendar, contacts, and task management.
(3) Yahoo Mail: A free email service provided by Yahoo, offering user-friendly themes, filters, and spam protection.
(4) AOL Mail: A free service offering unlimited storage and virus protection.
(5) Zoho Mail: A secure business email service that offers domain hosting and collaboration tools.
(6) ProtonMail: A secure email service that offers end-to-end encryption to protect user privacy.

brief.q: Define Recipient, Attachments, Password, and Email address.
a: Recipient: The person or group of people who receive an email message. The recipient's email address is entered in the 'To' field.
Attachments: Files (documents, images, videos) that are included with an email message.
Password: A secret code or phrase used to protect an email account from unauthorized access.
Email address: A unique identifier used to send and receive email messages, consisting of a username and a domain name (e.g. username@domain.com).

brief.q: Explain the standard protocols like SMTP and POP3.
a: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol): The principal email protocol responsible for the transfer of emails between email clients and email servers.
POP3 (Post Office Protocol 3): A protocol used by email clients to download emails from the server to local storage. It is primarily a one-way download protocol.

detailed.q: Prepare a presentation on a book, outlining introduction, analysis, conclusion, and tools used.
a: Outline for Book Presentation:
(1) Introduction: Introduce the book name, author, and summarize the plot briefly.
(2) Analysis: Use SWOT analysis (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) to analyze the book content.
(3) Conclusion: Summarize main points and encourage students to read more literature.
(4) PowerPoint Tools used: Animations, slide transitions, slide layouts, text formatting, and inserted images.

detailed.q: Create an email address using common freely available platforms like Microsoft or Google.
a: Steps to Create a Gmail Address:
1. Go to the Google sign-up page (accounts.google.com).
2. Click on 'Create account' and fill in your first and last name.
3. Choose a unique username before the @gmail.com domain.
4. Create a strong password containing letters, numbers, and symbols.
5. Enter recovery information (phone number or recovery email).
6. Accept Google's Terms of Service to complete the process.

detailed.q: Ask the students to write 3 things they have learned about email and 2 personal connections.

detailed.q: Differentiate between PowerPoint slide design layouts and animations.
a: Slide layout defines the organization of placeholders for titles, text, images, and charts.
Animations apply motion effects to individual elements (such as text box fly-in, image fade) on a slide.

crq.q: What is a word processor?
a: A word processor is a computer program or application software that allows users to enter, format, edit, save, and print text.

crq.q: What is Microsoft Word?
a: Microsoft Word is a popular word processing program used mainly for creating documents such as letters, brochures, learning activities, quizzes, tests, and student homework assignments.

crq.q: How do you open a new document in Word?
a: 1. Open Word, or if Word is already open, select File > New.
2. Click Blank Document, or select a template.

crq.q: What are some common features of Microsoft Word?
a: Some of the most common features of Word include text formatting, editing, font styles (bold, italic, underline), resizing font size, alignment, margins, page layouts, and inserting tables/images.

crq.q: What is character formatting in Word?
a: Formatting that you apply to text is referred to as character formatting. In a Word document, you can apply character formatting such as font face, size, bold, italic, underline, subscript, superscript, color, and text highlights.

crq.q: How can you apply character formatting to text?
a: To format any text in a Word document, you need to select the text first, then apply formatting using the buttons on the Home tab ribbon.

crq.q: What are the three types of font styles on the Home tab?
a: The three basic font styles on the Home tab in Word are Bold, Italics, and Underline.

crq.q: Why is it important to save a Word document?
a: It is important to save a Word document after writing text in it so that it can be stored permanently and accessed later without losing any data.

crq.q: How can you save a Word document?
a: To save a Word document, click the File tab, select Save, choose a folder, type a filename, and click Save. Alternatively, press the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + S.

crq.q: How can you open a saved file in Word?
a: To open a saved file in Word, go to the File tab, click Open, navigate to the folder containing your file, select the file, and click Open.
